items.title: The filtered-colimit extension of an additive functor is additive and commutes with arbitrary direct sums
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Additivity is executed via the two-out-of-sums criterion (homology-lemma-additive-functor) with an explicit four-step colimit computation for M ⊕ M', and direct sums are written as filtered colimits of finite sub-sums with a three-step computation whose second equality reuses the already-proven additivity.
